title: Ballot commitments, Pedersen VSS shares and validity proofs
generator: Printed by packages/crypto/scripts/ballot-validity-vectors.py, an implementation of docs/spec/ballot-validity.md with Python's integers and hashlib, sharing no code with packages/crypto or @noble/curves; it reuses only group-vectors.py's ristretto255 and RFC 9380 code (written from the RFCs and self-checked against them). Every valid ballot is checked by its verifier and every share by its share check before printing, and every invalid vector is checked to fail with the code it lists. The randomness is SHA-512 of fixed labels: test data only.
